**Self-contained type casting.** ActiveJob only depends on `activesupport` and `globalid` (not `activemodel`), so I implemented a small `Attributes::Type` module with lightweight casters (`:string`, `:integer`, `:float`, `:boolean`) that mirror ActiveModel semantics — `'42' → 42`, `'0' → false`, `nil → nil`. **Class-level `attribute` declaration.** `attribute(name, type, **options)` looks up the caster, stores a `Definition` (name/type/default) in a `class_attribute` registry, and defines the reader/writer instance methods.
